mentions.name: Sentialytics
mentions.description: This tool helps managers improve team performance by monitoring team well-being through short, anonymous weekly surveys that take under 60 seconds to complete. AI analyzes survey comments to identify recurring themes and deliver actionable insights and suggestions, so managers can make better decisions without reading hundreds of open-ended responses.
mentions.problem: The author, from experience as a manager, realized they weren't monitoring their team's well-being closely enough and it was starting to impact team performance.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Sentialytics (https://www.sentialytics.com/), a tool to help managers improve team performance by monitoring well-being via short, weekly surveys.
